mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message (conversation_id, user_id, role, content, intent, task_id, stream_interrupted) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{intent}, #{taskId}, COALESCE(#{streamInterrupted}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, intent, task_id, stream_interrupted, created_at FROM ( SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, role, content, intent, task_id, stream_interrupted, created_at FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
